race.comment: CONOR FIRE (4) is better than last start when seventh (20.70) in a Restricted WIN at Capalaba over 366m. The form out of his last race has been franked. Has ability and can bounce back. SASSY SIREN (2) was a winner two back then strongly fancied last time but could only manage a second (16.70) at this track. Has good speed and a low draw is a big help. Leading player again. TYANA BURN (1) claimed her maiden two back when strongly fancied to break through then second last time, beaten 3 lengths (17.02) at this track over 300m. Returns to the scene of her maiden win. Expected to be in the finish again. GOLDEN DRUMMER (8) can sneak into the finish with the right run.
